items.correctRationale: A solution must make the original equation true.

items.prompt: Which relation is not a function?

distractors.rationale: Each input in this set has only one output, so the relation satisfies the function rule.
A nonvertical linear equation such as y=3x+1 assigns exactly one y-value to each x-value.
Functions may send different inputs to the same output; repeated outputs do not violate the definition.

items.correctRationale: Add exponents for the same base.

distractors.rationale: When multiplying powers with the same base, exponents are added, not multiplied.
Subtracting exponents is associated with division of like bases, not multiplication.
Multiplying x-powers does not create a coefficient of 2 when both original coefficients are 1.

The coefficient -4 does not make the degree 4.
